title: Invertibility of the coefficient-unit bundle purity map
statement: In the setting of [def-trf-bundle-section-orientation-data], for any N>0 annihilating finite A and invertible on Noetherian S, the rank-d vector bundle admits an inverse projection isomorphism p whose inverse is the canonical coefficient-first projection map at A_S, and the specified bundleSectionPurityUnitMap(p) is invertible. This is an assertion about the fixed integration mate, not an arbitrary purity isomorphism.

proof.text: The finite projection formula makes the proper/open projection invertible. Conjugate by the signed symmetries and take its canonical inverse isomorphism p; its inverse is the specified projection arrow.
Apply vectorIntegrationMate_isIso at the unit. Precompose its invertible adjunct with inverse bundleSectionPurityUnitIso, which is the canonical pullback-unit/tensor-unitor comparison.
